// REFCYCLE - refrigeration cycle and service calculator for HVACR
// classes, for the HP Prime (G1 or G2), written in HP PPL.
//
// The home screen has twenty tiles: the refrigeration cycle (state points
// and performance from saturation temperatures or gauge pressures),
// saturated and superheated refrigerant properties, capacity and mass
// flow, compressor displacement and volumetric efficiency, efficiency
// ratings, water loads, walk-in box loads (walls, product, equipment
// size), the EPA leak rate and evacuation rules, charge records, service
// invoices, markup and margin, a time sheet, a unit converter, and Learn.
//
// Refrigerant properties come from CoolProp in I-P units with the ASHRAE
// reference state (h and s are 0 for saturated liquid at -40 F).  The
// TABLES block is generated by tools/gen_cycle_tables.py.

// units of the unit converter, by kind
convUnits(k)
BEGIN
  IF k==1 THEN RETURN {"Btu/lb","kJ/kg"}; END;
  IF k==2 THEN RETURN {"Btu/lb °F","kJ/kg K"}; END;
  IF k==3 THEN RETURN {"ft³/lb","m³/kg","L/kg"}; END;
  IF k==4 THEN RETURN {"Btu/h","tons","kW","MBH"}; END;
  IF k==5 THEN RETURN {"psi","kPa","bar","in Hg"}; END;
  RETURN {"lb/min","lb/h","kg/s","kg/h"};
END;

// property table of refrigerant r: 1 saturation, 2 h, 3 s, 4 v
refTab(r,k)
BEGIN
  IF r==1 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat1; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH1; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS1; END;
    RETURN gV1;
  END;
  IF r==2 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat2; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH2; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS2; END;
    RETURN gV2;
  END;
  IF r==3 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat3; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH3; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS3; END;
    RETURN gV3;
  END;
  IF r==4 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat4; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH4; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS4; END;
    RETURN gV4;
  END;
  IF r==5 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat5; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH5; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS5; END;
    RETURN gV5;
  END;
  IF r==6 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat6; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH6; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS6; END;
    RETURN gV6;
  END;
  IF r==7 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat7; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH7; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS7; END;
    RETURN gV7;
  END;
  IF r==8 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat8; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH8; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS8; END;
    RETURN gV8;
  END;
  IF r==9 THEN
    IF k==1 THEN RETURN gSat9; END;
    IF k==2 THEN RETURN gH9; END;
    IF k==3 THEN RETURN gS9; END;
    RETURN gV9;
  END;
  RETURN gSat1;
END;

// input boxes of each tool, two per row
toolIns(t)
BEGIN
  IF t==1 THEN RETURN {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8}; END;
  IF t==2 THEN RETURN {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8}; END;
  IF t==3 THEN RETURN {9,10}; END;
  IF t==4 THEN RETURN {11,12,13}; END;
  IF t==5 THEN RETURN {14,15,16}; END;
  IF t==6 THEN RETURN {17,18,19,20,21}; END;
  IF t==7 THEN RETURN {22,23,24,25}; END;
  IF t==8 THEN RETURN {26,27}; END;
  IF t==9 THEN RETURN {28,29,30,31,32}; END;
  IF t==10 THEN RETURN {33,34,35,36,37,38}; END;
  IF t==11 THEN RETURN {39,40,41,42,43,44,45,46}; END;
  IF t==12 THEN RETURN {47,48,49,50,51,52}; END;
  IF t==13 THEN RETURN {53,54,55,56,57,58}; END;
  IF t==14 THEN RETURN {59,60,61,62}; END;
  IF t==15 THEN RETURN {63,64,65,66}; END;
  IF t==16 THEN RETURN {67,68,69,70,71,72,73,74}; END;
  IF t==17 THEN RETURN {75,76,77}; END;
  IF t==18 THEN RETURN {78,79,80,81,82,83,84}; END;

  RETURN {};
END;

// fixed choice lists (12 = the converter's units)
choiceList(c)
BEGIN
  IF c==1 THEN RETURN {"R-22","R-410A","R-134a","R-404A","R-407C","R-32","R-507A","R-290","R-12"}; END;
  IF c==2 THEN RETURN {"Sat temps °F","Gauge psig"}; END;
  IF c==3 THEN RETURN {"EER","COP","kW per ton"}; END;
  IF c==4 THEN RETURN {"Comfort cooling","Commercial refrig.","Industrial process","Other / transport","Res./light comm. AC"}; END;
  IF c==5 THEN RETURN {"HFC / HFO","CFC / HCFC"}; END;
  IF c==6 THEN RETURN {"Annualizing","Rolling average"}; END;
  IF c==7 THEN RETURN {"R-22","R-410A","R-134a","R-404A","R-407C","R-32","R-507A","R-290","R-12","R-11","R-123","R-113","R-245fa","R-114","R-124","R-500","R-407A","R-502","R-13","R-23","R-503","R-508B"}; END;
  IF c==8 THEN RETURN {"1993 or later","Before 1993"}; END;
  IF c==9 THEN RETURN {"No","Yes, runs","Yes, dead"}; END;
  IF c==11 THEN RETURN {"Enthalpy","Entropy / cp","Volume","Capacity","Pressure","Mass flow"}; END;
  RETURN convUnits(gV(85));
END;

// ================= number formatting =================

// whole number as text, independent of the calculator's number format
istr(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n:=ROUND(ABS(v),0);
  LOCAL s:="";
  IF n<1 THEN RETURN "0"; END;
  WHILE n>=1 DO
    s:=CHAR(48+(n MOD 10))+s;
    n:=IP(n/10);
  END;
  IF v<0 THEN s:="-"+s; END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// one decimal place
fmt1(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n:=ROUND(ABS(v)*10,0);
  LOCAL s:=istr(IP(n/10))+"."+CHAR(48+(n MOD 10));
  IF v<0 AND n>0 THEN s:="-"+s; END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// v with d decimal places (d = 0 to 5)
fmtN(v,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL m:=10^d;
  LOCAL n:=ROUND(ABS(v)*m,0);
  LOCAL s:=istr(IP(n/m));
  LOCAL f;
  IF d>0 THEN
    f:=istr(n MOD m);
    WHILE DIM(f)<d DO f:="0"+f; END;
    s:=s+"."+f;
  END;
  IF v<0 AND n>0 THEN s:="-"+s; END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// up to d decimals, trailing zeros dropped
fmtTr(v,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL s:=fmtN(v,d);
  IF d>0 THEN
    WHILE RIGHT(s,1)=="0" DO s:=LEFT(s,DIM(s)-1); END;
    IF RIGHT(s,1)=="." THEN s:=LEFT(s,DIM(s)-1); END;
  END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// any size of number; very large or small ones as 1.23E-6
fmtE(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL a:=ABS(v);
  LOCAL ex, m;
  IF a<0.000000000001 THEN RETURN "0"; END;
  IF a>=0.001 AND a<10000000 THEN
    // six significant figures
    ex:=5;
    IF a>=10 THEN ex:=4; END;
    IF a>=100 THEN ex:=3; END;
    IF a>=1000 THEN ex:=2; END;
    IF a>=10000 THEN ex:=1; END;
    IF a>=100000 THEN ex:=0; END;
    RETURN fmtTr(v,ex);
  END;
  ex:=FLOOR(LN(a)/LN(10));
  m:=a/10^ex;
  IF m>=9.9995 THEN
    m:=m/10;
    ex:=ex+1;
  END;
  IF m<1 THEN
    m:=m*10;
    ex:=ex-1;
  END;
  RETURN IFTE(v<0,"-","")+fmtTr(m,3)+"E"+istr(ex);
END;

// ================= refrigerant properties =================

sqroot(x)
BEGIN
  RETURN MAX(0,x)^0.5;
END;

// whole number with thousands commas, e.g. 100,000
ithou(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL s:=istr(ABS(v));
  LOCAL o:="";
  WHILE DIM(s)>3 DO
    o:=","+RIGHT(s,3)+o;
    s:=LEFT(s,DIM(s)-3);
  END;
  RETURN IFTE(v<0 AND ROUND(ABS(v),0)>0,"-","")+s+o;
END;

// pounds as pounds and ounces, e.g. 3 lb 8.0 oz
fmtLbOz(lb)
BEGIN
  LOCAL a:=ABS(lb);
  LOCAL w:=IP(a+0.00001);
  LOCAL oz:=(a-w)*16;
  RETURN IFTE(lb<0,"-","")+istr(w)+" lb "+fmt1(oz)+" oz";
END;

// quadratic through f0, f1, f2 at 0, 1, 2, evaluated at u
q3(f0,f1,f2,u)
BEGIN
  RETURN f0*(u-1)*(u-2)/2-f1*u*(u-2)+f2*u*(u-1)/2;
END;

// first of the three grid points used around position x (0 based), n points
q3i(x,n)
BEGIN
  RETURN MAX(0,MIN(n-3,FLOOR(x+0.5)-1));
END;

// saturation property of refrigerant r at t F: c 1 bubble psia, 2 dew psia,
// 3 bubble liquid enthalpy (Btu/lb)
satP(r,t,c)
BEGIN
  LOCAL m:=refTab(r,1);
  LOCAL x:=(t+40)/5;
  LOCAL ix:=q3i((t+40)/5,37);
  LOCAL u:=x-ix;
  IF c==3 THEN RETURN q3(m(ix+1,3),m(ix+2,3),m(ix+3,3),u)/1000; END;
  RETURN EXP(q3(LN(m(ix+1,c)),LN(m(ix+2,c)),LN(m(ix+3,c)),u))/1000;
END;

// vapor property at dew temperature t and superheat sh: k 2 enthalpy
// (Btu/lb), 3 entropy (Btu/lb R), 4 specific volume (ft3/lb)
vapP(r,t,sh,k)
BEGIN
  LOCAL m:=refTab(r,k);
  LOCAL x:=(t+40)/5;
  LOCAL y:=sh/10;
  LOCAL ix:=q3i((t+40)/5,37);
  LOCAL jx:=q3i(sh/10,21);
  LOCAL u, w, a, b, c;
  u:=x-ix;
  w:=y-jx;
  IF k==4 THEN
    a:=q3(LN(m(ix+1,jx+1)),LN(m(ix+1,jx+2)),LN(m(ix+1,jx+3)),w);
    b:=q3(LN(m(ix+2,jx+1)),LN(m(ix+2,jx+2)),LN(m(ix+2,jx+3)),w);
    c:=q3(LN(m(ix+3,jx+1)),LN(m(ix+3,jx+2)),LN(m(ix+3,jx+3)),w);
    RETURN EXP(q3(a,b,c,u))/100000;
  END;
  a:=q3(m(ix+1,jx+1),m(ix+1,jx+2),m(ix+1,jx+3),w);
  b:=q3(m(ix+2,jx+1),m(ix+2,jx+2),m(ix+2,jx+3),w);
  c:=q3(m(ix+3,jx+1),m(ix+3,jx+2),m(ix+3,jx+3),w);
  RETURN q3(a,b,c,u)/IFTE(k==2,1000,100000);
END;

// saturation temperature at p psia: c 1 bubble, 2 dew
tFromP(r,p,c)
BEGIN
  LOCAL lo:=-40;
  LOCAL hi:=140;
  LOCAL k, md;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO 40 DO
    md:=(lo+hi)/2;
    IF satP(r,md,c)<p THEN lo:=md; ELSE hi:=md; END;
  END;
  RETURN (lo+hi)/2;
END;

// superheat at dew temperature t where property k (2 h, 3 s) equals v
shFrom(r,t,k,v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL lo:=0;
  LOCAL hi:=200;
  LOCAL n, md;
  FOR n FROM 1 TO 40 DO
    md:=(lo+hi)/2;
    IF vapP(r,t,md,k)<v THEN lo:=md; ELSE hi:=md; END;
  END;
  RETURN (lo+hi)/2;
END;

// the refrigeration cycle of the cycle boxes, into gCy; status 1 = good,
// 0 = outside the tables (message in gCy(13) as a code: 2 temps, 3 order,
// 4 discharge past the table)
cycle()
BEGIN
  LOCAL r:=gV(1);
  LOCAL te, tc, pe, pc, h1, s1, v1;
  LOCAL sh2, h2s, h2, t2, h3, t3, tb;
  LOCAL hfe, hge, x4;
  IF gV(2)==1 THEN
    te:=gV(3);
    tc:=gV(4);
    IF te<-40 OR te>140 OR tc<-40 OR tc>140 THEN
      gCy(13):=2;
      RETURN 0;
    END;
    pe:=satP(r,te,2);
    pc:=satP(r,tc,2);
  ELSE
    pe:=gV(3)+14.696;
    pc:=gV(4)+14.696;
    IF pe<satP(r,-40,2) OR pe>satP(r,140,2) OR pc<satP(r,-40,2) OR pc>satP(r,140,2) THEN
      gCy(13):=2;
      RETURN 0;
    END;
    te:=tFromP(r,pe,2);
    tc:=tFromP(r,pc,2);
  END;
  IF tc<=te+1 THEN
    gCy(13):=3;
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  h1:=vapP(r,te,gV(5),2);
  s1:=vapP(r,te,gV(5),3);
  v1:=vapP(r,te,gV(5),4);
  IF vapP(r,tc,200,3)<s1 THEN
    gCy(13):=4;
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  sh2:=IFTE(vapP(r,tc,0,3)>=s1,0,shFrom(r,tc,3,s1));
  h2s:=vapP(r,tc,sh2,2);
  h2:=h1+(h2s-h1)/(gV(7)/100);
  IF vapP(r,tc,200,2)<h2 THEN
    gCy(13):=4;
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  t2:=tc+shFrom(r,tc,2,h2);
  tb:=tFromP(r,pc,1);
  t3:=MAX(-40,tb-gV(6));
  h3:=satP(r,t3,3);
  hfe:=satP(r,tFromP(r,pe,1),3);
  hge:=vapP(r,te,0,2);
  x4:=(h3-hfe)/(hge-hfe);
  gCy:={te,tc,pe,pc,h1,s1,v1,h2,t2,h3,t3,x4,1};
  RETURN 1;
END;

// ================= drawing helpers (all draw into G1) =================

textw(s,fnt)
BEGIN
  LOCAL w:=TEXTOUT_P(s,G9,0,0,fnt);
  IF w<=0 THEN w:=DIM(s)*(4+fnt); END;
  RETURN w;
END;

// text centred on x, top edge at y
ctext(s,x,y,fnt,c)
BEGIN
  TEXTOUT_P(s,G1,x-textw(s,fnt)/2,y,fnt,c);
END;

// text right aligned to x, top edge at y
rtext(s,x,y,fnt,c)
BEGIN
  TEXTOUT_P(s,G1,x-textw(s,fnt),y,fnt,c);
END;

// 2-pixel outline
box2(x1,y1,x2,y2,c)
BEGIN
  RECT_P(G1,x1,y1,x2,y1+1,c);
  RECT_P(G1,x1,y2-1,x2,y2,c);
  RECT_P(G1,x1,y1,x1+1,y2,c);
  RECT_P(G1,x2-1,y1,x2,y2,c);
END;

// small button in the title bar
chip(s,x)
BEGIN
  RECT_P(G1,x,2,x+44,18,cEdge,cBtn);
  ctext(s,x+22,5,1,cText);
END;

// row of five touch buttons along the bottom of the screen
drawMenu(lst)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO 5 DO
    RECT_P(G1,(k-1)*64,220,k*64-2,239,cEdge,cBtn);
    ctext(lst(k),(k-1)*64+31,225,1,cText);
  END;
END;

// ================= input boxes =================

// the conduit trade size box is only used when finding wires that fit
slotName(s)
BEGIN
  RETURN gSL(s);
END;

slotUnit(s)
BEGIN
  IF s==3 OR s==4 THEN RETURN IFTE(gV(2)==1,"°F","psig"); END;
  RETURN gSU(s);
END;

// text shown in an input box
slotText(s)
BEGIN
  LOCAL u:=slotUnit(s);
  LOCAL v:=gV(s);
  LOCAL lst, t;
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN
    lst:=choiceList(gSC(s));
    RETURN lst(MAX(1,MIN(SIZE(lst),v)));
  END;
  IF v==0 AND gSZ(s)==1 THEN RETURN "--"; END;
  IF v==0 AND gSZ(s)==2 THEN RETURN "?"; END;
  IF gSD(s)<0 THEN t:=fmtTr(v,4); ELSE t:=fmtN(v,gSD(s)); END;
  IF u=="" THEN RETURN t; END;
  IF LEFT(u,1)=="°" THEN RETURN t+u; END;
  RETURN t+" "+u;
END;

// the evaporator and condenser boxes change from temperatures to gauge
// pressures (mode 2) or back (mode 1)
cycConv(md)
BEGIN
  LOCAL r:=gV(1);
  IF md==2 THEN
    gV(3):=ROUND(satP(r,MAX(-40,MIN(140,gV(3))),2)-14.696,1);
    gV(4):=ROUND(satP(r,MAX(-40,MIN(140,gV(4))),2)-14.696,1);
  ELSE
    gV(3):=ROUND(tFromP(r,MAX(satP(r,-40,2),MIN(satP(r,140,2),gV(3)+14.696)),2),1);
    gV(4):=ROUND(tFromP(r,MAX(satP(r,-40,2),MIN(satP(r,140,2),gV(4)+14.696)),2),1);
  END;
END;

setSlot(s,v)
BEGIN
  gV(s):=MAX(gSLo(s),MIN(gSHi(s),v));
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN gV(s):=ROUND(gV(s),0); END;
  IF s==2 THEN cycConv(gV(2)); END;
  IF s==85 THEN gV(87):=1; END;
END;

// Up/Down: step a number, or move through a choice list
bumpSlot(s,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n;
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN
    n:=SIZE(choiceList(gSC(s)));
    gV(s):=gV(s)+IFTE(d>0,1,-1);
    IF gV(s)>n THEN gV(s):=1; END;
    IF gV(s)<1 THEN gV(s):=n; END;
    IF s==2 THEN cycConv(gV(2)); END;
    IF s==85 THEN gV(87):=1; END;
  ELSE
    setSlot(s,gV(s)+d*gSS(s));
  END;
END;

// a two-way choice flips, a longer list opens, a number opens a dialog
editSlot(s)
BEGIN
  LOCAL v:=gV(s);
  LOCAL lst;
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN
    lst:=choiceList(gSC(s));
    IF SIZE(lst)==2 THEN
      setSlot(s,IFTE(v==1,2,1));
    ELSE
      IF CHOOSE(v,slotName(s),lst) THEN
        IF v>=1 THEN setSlot(s,v); END;
      END;
    END;
  ELSE
    IF INPUT(v,slotName(s),slotName(s)+":",gSH(s)) THEN
      IF TYPE(v)==0 THEN setSlot(s,v); END;
    END;
  END;
  gDown:=0;
END;

// ---- typing a number straight into the selected box ----

// key code -> digit 0-9, 10 for the decimal point, -1 for other keys
keyDigit(ev)
BEGIN
  LOCAL kc:={47,42,43,44,37,38,39,32,33,34,48};
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO 11 DO
    IF ev==kc(k) THEN RETURN k-1; END;
  END;
  RETURN -1;
END;

entText()
BEGIN
  LOCAL s:=IFTE(gENeg,"-","");
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK) DO
    s:=s+IFTE(gEK(k)==10,".",CHAR(48+gEK(k)));
  END;
  RETURN s;
END;

entVal()
BEGIN
  LOCAL v:=0;
  LOCAL sc:=0;
  LOCAL k, d;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK) DO
    d:=gEK(k);
    IF d==10 THEN
      sc:=1;
    ELSE
      IF sc>0 THEN
        sc:=sc/10;
        v:=v+d*sc;
      ELSE
        v:=v*10+d;
      END;
    END;
  END;
  RETURN IFTE(gENeg,-v,v);
END;

typeKey(d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL hasdot:=0;
  LOCAL k;
  IF gEnt==0 THEN
    gEnt:=1;
    gEK:={};
    gENeg:=0;
  END;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK) DO
    IF gEK(k)==10 THEN hasdot:=1; END;
  END;
  IF (d<10 OR hasdot==0) AND SIZE(gEK)<12 THEN gEK(SIZE(gEK)+1):=d; END;
END;

backKey()
BEGIN
  LOCAL nl:={};
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK)-1 DO
    nl(k):=gEK(k);
  END;
  gEK:=nl;
  IF SIZE(gEK)==0 THEN gEnt:=0; END;
END;

// store the typed number (if any) in the selected box
commitEnt()
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  IF gEnt AND SIZE(gEK)>0 THEN setSlot(sl(gTSel),entVal()); END;
  gEnt:=0;
END;

// ================= help =================

// full-screen page of text; lines that start with a space are body text
showText(ttl,t)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k, ev;
  LOCAL done:=0;
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,239,cBg);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,20,cPanel);
  TEXTOUT_P(ttl,G1,5,4,2,cText);
  rtext("tap or press a key",314,6,1,cDim);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(t) DO
    TEXTOUT_P(t(k),G1,6,10+k*14,1,IFTE(LEFT(t(k),1)==" ",cText,cSelc));
  END;
  BLIT_P(G0,G1);
  REPEAT
    ev:=WAIT(-1);
    IF TYPE(ev)==6 THEN
      IF ev(1)==3 THEN done:=1; END;
    ELSE
      IF ev>=0 THEN done:=1; END;
    END;
  UNTIL done;
  gDown:=0;
END;

showHelp()
BEGIN
  showText("REFCYCLE",{
    "TILES",
    " Tap a tile (or use the arrows and Enter).",
    " Learn: cycle, EPA and service notes.  Esc: quit.",
    "INSIDE A TOOL",
    " Tap a box to type a number or pick a choice.",
    " Or select a box with Left/Right and just type",
    " the number on the keypad, then press Enter.",
    " Up/Down: step the value.  Del: erase a digit.",
    " RESET puts that tool's example values back.",
    " HELP shows the rule the tool uses.",
    "SOURCES",
    " Properties: CoolProp, ASHRAE reference (h = 0",
    " for liquid at -40°F). EPA: 40 CFR 82.152, 82.156,",
    " 82.157, 84.102, 84.106 (current Oct 2026)."});
END;

// reference page n (the Learn tile, and each tool's HELP)
learnPage(n)
BEGIN
  LOCAL h:={" No notes."};
  IF n==1 THEN h:={
    "THE REFRIGERATION CYCLE",
    " 1 Compressor inlet: superheated vapor, suction",
    "   pressure (evaporating temp + superheat).",
    " 2 Compressor outlet: hot gas at head pressure.",
    "   Ideal compression keeps entropy constant; a real",
    "   compressor adds more heat (efficiency < 100%).",
    " 3 Condenser outlet: subcooled liquid (condensing",
    "   temp - subcooling).",
    " 4 Metering device outlet: same enthalpy as 3",
    "   (h4 = h3), now a mix of liquid and flash gas.",
    " 4 to 1 evaporator: absorbs the heat (the effect).",
    " Blends: evaporating and condensing temps are dew",
    " points (as on compressor ratings); the liquid",
    " uses the bubble point at head pressure."}; END;
  IF n==2 THEN h:={
    "CYCLE NUMBERS",
    "  Refrigeration effect RE = h1 - h4  (Btu/lb)",
    "  Heat of compression HOC = h2 - h1",
    "  Heat of rejection = h2 - h3 = RE + HOC",
    "  COP = RE / HOC      EER = 3.412 x COP",
    "  lb/min = 200 x tons / RE",
    "  (1 ton = 12,000 Btu/h = 200 Btu/min)",
    "  Suction CFM = lb/min x specific volume at 1",
    "  Compression ratio = head psia / suction psia",
    "  psia = psig + 14.7",
    "  Flash gas = (h4 - hf) / (hg - hf), hf and hg",
    "  at the evaporator pressure"}; END;
  IF n==3 THEN h:={
    "ENTHALPY REFERENCE",
    " This app uses the ASHRAE reference: enthalpy and",
    " entropy are 0 for saturated liquid at -40°F.",
    " P-H charts from other sources may start from a",
    " different reference (for example 200 kJ/kg at",
    " 32°F). The h values then differ by a constant,",
    " but every DIFFERENCE (RE, HOC, heat of rejection,",
    " COP, flow) comes out the same.",
    " Read a chart: find the pressure line, follow it",
    " to the temperature line, read h straight down.",
    " Properties: CoolProp (REFPROP-quality equations)."}; END;
  IF n==4 THEN h:={
    "COMPRESSORS",
    "  Displacement CFM = 0.7854 x bore² x stroke",
    "     x cylinders x RPM / 1728   (inches)",
    "  Actual CFM = displacement x volumetric eff.",
    "  lb/min = actual CFM / suction specific volume",
    " Volumetric efficiency falls as the compression",
    " ratio rises (gas left in the clearance space",
    " re-expands):",
    "  Ve = 1 - C x ((Pd / Ps)^(1/n) - 1)",
    "  C = clearance fraction, P in psia, n about 1.15",
    " Low suction or high head: higher ratio, less",
    " capacity, hotter discharge."}; END;
  IF n==5 THEN h:={
    "WALK-IN BOX LOADS",
    " Walls: Btu/h = area x (1 / R) x temp difference;",
    " all six surfaces, x 24 for a day.",
    " Product: sensible above freezing (lb x cp x dT),",
    " latent to freeze (lb x latent heat), sensible",
    " below freezing (lb x cp below x dT).",
    " Water: cp 1.0 above, 144 Btu/lb latent, 0.5 ice.",
    " Add air changes (door openings) and other loads",
    " (lights W x 3.412, people, fan motors).",
    " Add the safety factor, then divide by the run",
    " time (16 h coolers, 18-20 h freezers are common",
    " to allow defrost) for the equipment Btu/h."}; END;
  IF n==6 THEN h:={
    "EPA LEAK REPAIR: HFC (40 CFR 84.106)",
    " From January 1, 2026: appliances with 15 lb or",
    " more of an HFC or substitute with GWP over 53.",
    " Not residential or light commercial A/C and",
    " heat pumps.",
    " Leak rate limits: comfort cooling and other 10%,",
    " commercial refrigeration 20%, industrial",
    " process 30%.",
    " Over the limit: find and repair the leaks within",
    " 30 days of adding refrigerant (120 days if an",
    " industrial process shutdown is needed), with an",
    " initial verification test within 30 days and a",
    " follow-up test within 10 days of it.",
    " Repairs by a certified technician."}; END;
  IF n==7 THEN h:={
    "EPA LEAK REPAIR: CFC/HCFC (82.157)",
    " Appliances with 50 lb or more of a class I or",
    " class II (CFC or HCFC) refrigerant, such as R-22.",
    " Same limits: 10% comfort cooling, 20% commercial",
    " refrigeration, 30% industrial process.",
    "LEAK RATE METHODS (84.102)",
    " Annualizing: lb added / full charge x 365 /",
    " (days since the last addition, max 365) x 100",
    " Rolling average: lb added in the last 365 days",
    " (or since the last successful follow-up test) /",
    " full charge x 100",
    " A facility uses one method for all appliances.",
    " Calculate it every time refrigerant is added."}; END;
  IF n==8 THEN h:={
    "EPA RECORDS",
    " Keep records 3 years. For each service of an",
    " appliance of 15 lb or more: the appliance and",
    " its location, the date, the parts serviced, the",
    " work done, who did it, the refrigerant type and",
    " amount added (or removed), the full charge.",
    " Owners record each appliance's full charge and",
    " how it was found.",
    " Chronic leakers: 125% or more of the full charge",
    " lost in a calendar year must be reported to EPA",
    " by March 1 of the next year (84.106(j)).",
    " Disposal of 5-50 lb appliances: technicians keep",
    " recovery records 3 years (82.156(a)(3))."}; END;
  IF n==9 THEN h:={
    "EPA EVACUATION LEVELS (82.156 TABLE 1)",
    " Liquid pressure at 104°F sets the class (82.152):",
    "  low under 45 psia, medium 45-170,",
    "  high 170-355, very high over 355 psia.",
    " Inches of Hg vacuum, recovery unit made on/after",
    " Nov 15, 1993 (before):",
    "  very high: 0 (0)   high, under 200 lb: 0 (0)",
    "  high, 200 lb+: 10 (4)",
    "  medium, under 200 lb: 10 (4)",
    "  medium, 200 lb+: 15 (4)",
    "  low: 25 mm Hg absolute",
    " Small appliances: recover 90% (80% if the",
    " compressor is dead or the unit is pre-1993) or",
    " pull to 4 in Hg vacuum. Non-major repairs: 0 psig."}; END;
  IF n==10 THEN h:={
    "ARKANSAS HVACR LICENSES",
    " Class A: HVACR work, no size limit.",
    " Class B: A/C up to 15 tons or 1 million Btu/h",
    " heating per unit, refrigeration 15 hp or less.",
    " Class C: service, repair and replace components",
    " within the Class B limits; may not install or",
    " replace equipment.",
    " Class D: sheet metal (ductwork) only.",
    " Class E: refrigeration work, any size; not",
    " comfort heating or cooling.",
    " Class L: lifetime service license (65+), Class B",
    " limits, service only.",
    " Mechanical code: IMC 2021 (HVACR Board).",
    " Source: HVACR Licensing Board rules (2022)."}; END;
  IF n==11 THEN h:={
    "SERVICE PAPERWORK",
    "  Markup % = (price - cost) / cost x 100",
    "  Margin % = (price - cost) / price x 100",
    "  Price = cost x (1 + markup) = cost / (1 - margin)",
    "  50% markup = 33.3% margin; 100% markup = 50%",
    " Invoice: labor, parts, refrigerant (lb x price),",
    " trip charge, tax where it applies.",
    " Refrigerant log: weigh the cylinder before and",
    " after; record the type, amount, appliance and",
    " date for the EPA records.",
    " Overtime: hours over 40 in a week at 1.5 x."}; END;
  IF n==12 THEN h:={
    "WATER AND RATINGS",
    "  Btu/h = 500 x GPM x temperature difference",
    "  (500 = 8.33 lb/gal x 60 min x 1 Btu/lb°F)",
    "  tons = Btu/h / 12,000",
    "  Chilled water: 2.4 GPM per ton at 10°F rise",
    "  Cooling tower: range = entering - leaving water;",
    "  approach = leaving water - air wet bulb",
    "  EER = Btu/h / watts = 3.412 x COP",
    "  kW per ton = 12 / EER"}; END;
  showText(gLearn(n),h);
END;

learnMenu()
BEGIN
  LOCAL t:=1;
  IF CHOOSE(t,"Learn",gLearn) THEN
    IF t>=1 THEN learnPage(t); END;
  END;
  gDown:=0;
END;

toolHelp(t)
BEGIN
  LOCAL pg:={1,2,3,3,2,4,4,12,12,5,5,5,6,9,8,11,11,11,3};
  learnPage(pg(t));
END;

// ================= tools =================

clearRows()
BEGIN
  gRL:={};
  gRV:={};
  gRN:={};
  gRC:={};
END;

addRow(l,v,n,c)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k:=SIZE(gRL)+1;
  gRL(k):=l;
  gRV(k):=v;
  gRN(k):=n;
  gRC(k):=c;
END;

// row explaining why the cycle could not be worked out
cycleFail()
BEGIN
  IF gCy(13)==3 THEN
    addRow("Check","condenser","must be above the evaporator",cBad);
  ELSE
    IF gCy(13)==4 THEN
      addRow("Discharge","over 200°F SH","past the property table",cBad);
    ELSE
      addRow("Out of range","-40 to 140°F","saturation temps only",cBad);
    END;
  END;
END;

calcPoints()
BEGIN
  IF cycle()==0 THEN
    cycleFail();
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  addRow("Evaporator",fmt1(gCy(1))+"°F",fmtN(gCy(3)-14.696,1)+" psig (dew)",cText);
  addRow("Condenser",fmt1(gCy(2))+"°F",fmtN(gCy(4)-14.696,1)+" psig (dew)",cText);
  addRow("1 Suction",fmtN(gCy(5),2)+" Btu/lb",fmt1(gCy(1)+gV(5))+"°F, "+fmtN(gCy(7),3)+" ft³/lb",cSelc);
  addRow("2 Discharge",fmtN(gCy(8),2)+" Btu/lb",fmt1(gCy(9))+"°F"+IFTE(gV(7)<100," actual"," (isentropic)"),cSelc);
  addRow("3 Liquid",fmtN(gCy(10),2)+" Btu/lb",fmt1(gCy(11))+"°F liquid",cSelc);
  addRow("4 Evap in",fmtN(gCy(10),2)+" Btu/lb","h4 = h3; flash gas "+fmt1(100*gCy(12))+"%",cSelc);
  addRow("Reference","","h = 0 Btu/lb for liquid at -40°F",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcPerf()
BEGIN
  LOCAL ef, hc, fl;
  IF cycle()==0 THEN
    cycleFail();
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  ef:=gCy(5)-gCy(10);
  hc:=gCy(8)-gCy(5);
  fl:=200*gV(8)/ef;
  addRow("Refrig. effect",fmtN(ef,2)+" Btu/lb","h1 - h4",cSelc);
  addRow("Heat of comp.",fmtN(hc,2)+" Btu/lb","h2 - h1; "+fmtN(fl*hc*60/3412.14,2)+" kW",cText);
  addRow("Heat rejected",fmtN(gCy(8)-gCy(10),2)+" Btu/lb","h2 - h3 = RE + HOC",cText);
  addRow("COP",fmtN(ef/hc,2),"EER "+fmtN(3.41214*ef/hc,2),cSelc);
  addRow("Mass flow",fmtN(fl,3)+" lb/min","for "+fmtTr(gV(8),2)+" tons: 200 x tons / RE",cText);
  addRow("Suction CFM",fmtN(fl*gCy(7),3),"lb/min x "+fmtN(gCy(7),3)+" ft³/lb",cText);
  addRow("Comp. ratio",fmtN(gCy(4)/gCy(3),2)+" : 1","head psia / suction psia",cText);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcSat()
BEGIN
  LOCAL r:=gV(9);
  LOCAL t:=gV(10);
  LOCAL pb:=satP(gV(9),gV(10),1);
  LOCAL pd:=satP(gV(9),gV(10),2);
  LOCAL hf:=satP(gV(9),gV(10),3);
  LOCAL hg:=vapP(gV(9),gV(10),0,2);
  addRow("Liquid psig",fmtN(pb-14.696,1),fmtN(pb,2)+" psia (bubble)",cSelc);
  addRow("Vapor psig",fmtN(pd-14.696,1),fmtN(pd,2)+" psia (dew)",cSelc);
  IF pb-pd>0.05 THEN addRow("Glide",fmt1(tFromP(r,pb,2)-t)+"°F","dew - bubble temp at "+fmtN(pb-14.696,1)+" psig",cText); END;
  addRow("h liquid",fmtN(hf,2)+" Btu/lb","saturated liquid (bubble)",cText);
  addRow("h vapor",fmtN(hg,2)+" Btu/lb","saturated vapor (dew)",cText);
  addRow("hg - hf",fmtN(hg-hf,2)+" Btu/lb","latent heat at this temp",cText);
  addRow("v vapor",fmtN(vapP(r,t,0,4),4)+" ft³/lb","s vapor "+fmtN(vapP(r,t,0,3),4),cText);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcSup()
BEGIN
  LOCAL r:=gV(11);
  LOCAL t:=gV(12);
  LOCAL sh:=gV(13);
  LOCAL pd:=satP(gV(11),gV(12),2);
  LOCAL v:=vapP(gV(11),gV(12),gV(13),4);
  addRow("Pressure",fmtN(pd-14.696,1)+" psig",fmtN(pd,2)+" psia",cText);
  addRow("Temperature",fmt1(t+sh)+"°F",fmt1(sh)+"°F superheat",cText);
  addRow("Enthalpy",fmtN(vapP(r,t,sh,2),2)+" Btu/lb","h",cSelc);
  addRow("Entropy",fmtN(vapP(r,t,sh,3),4),"Btu/lb °R",cSelc);
  addRow("Volume",fmtN(v,4)+" ft³/lb","density "+fmtN(1/v,3)+" lb/ft³",cSelc);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcFlow()
BEGIN
  LOCAL ef:=gV(14);
  LOCAL fl:=gV(15);
  LOCAL tn:=gV(16);
  IF fl>0 THEN
    addRow("Capacity",ithou(fl*ef*60)+" Btu/h","lb/min x RE x 60",cSelc);
    addRow("Tons",fmtN(fl*ef/200,3),"lb/min x RE / 200",cSelc);
  END;
  IF tn>0 THEN
    addRow("Flow needed",fmtN(200*tn/ef,3)+" lb/min","for "+fmtTr(tn,2)+" tons",cSelc);
    addRow("Per hour",fmtN(12000*tn/ef,1)+" lb/h","",cText);
  END;
  addRow("Rule","","1 ton = 200 Btu per minute",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcDisp()
BEGIN
  LOCAL dc:=0.7853981634*gV(17)^2*gV(18)*gV(19)*gV(20)/1728;
  LOCAL ac:=dc*gV(21)/100;
  LOCAL nm:=choiceList(1);
  LOCAL fl, ef;
  addRow("Displacement",fmtN(dc,2)+" CFM","swept volume x RPM",cText);
  addRow("Actual",fmtN(ac,2)+" CFM",fmtTr(gV(21),1)+"% volumetric efficiency",cSelc);
  IF cycle()==0 THEN
    cycleFail();
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  fl:=ac/gCy(7);
  ef:=gCy(5)-gCy(10);
  addRow("Suction gas",fmtN(gCy(7),3)+" ft³/lb",nm(gV(1))+" at "+fmt1(gCy(1))+"°F + "+fmtTr(gV(5),1)+" SH",cText);
  addRow("Mass flow",fmtN(fl,2)+" lb/min","actual CFM / volume",cText);
  addRow("Capacity",ithou(fl*ef*60)+" Btu/h",fmtN(fl*ef/200,2)+" tons at RE "+fmtN(ef,1),cSelc);
  addRow("Conditions","","from the Cycle tool's boxes",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcVe()
BEGIN
  LOCAL ps:=gV(23)+14.696;
  LOCAL pd:=gV(24)+14.696;
  LOCAL cr, ve;
  IF ps<=0 OR pd<=ps THEN
    addRow("Check","pressures","discharge above suction",cBad);
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  cr:=pd/ps;
  ve:=1-gV(22)/100*(cr^(1/gV(25))-1);
  addRow("Comp. ratio",fmtN(cr,2)+" : 1",fmtTr(pd,1)+" / "+fmtTr(ps,1)+" psia",cText);
  addRow("Vol. eff.",fmtN(100*ve,1)+"%","1 - C x (ratio^(1/n) - 1)",IFTE(ve>0,cSelc,cBad));
  addRow("Re-expansion",fmtN(100*(1-ve),1)+"%","of the stroke lost",cText);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcRate()
BEGIN
  LOCAL v:=gV(26);
  LOCAL eer:=IFTE(gV(27)==1,gV(26),IFTE(gV(27)==2,gV(26)*3.41214,12/gV(26)));
  addRow("EER",fmtN(eer,2),"Btu/h per watt",IFTE(gV(27)==1,cSelc,cText));
  addRow("COP",fmtN(eer/3.41214,3),"EER / 3.412",IFTE(gV(27)==2,cSelc,cText));
  addRow("kW per ton",fmtN(12/eer,3),"12 / EER",IFTE(gV(27)==3,cSelc,cText));
  addRow("Note","","SEER2 and HSPF2 are seasonal ratings",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcWater()
BEGIN
  LOCAL dt:=ABS(gV(29)-gV(30));
  LOCAL q:=gV(31)*gV(28)*ABS(gV(29)-gV(30));
  addRow("Load",ithou(q)+" Btu/h",istr(gV(31))+" x GPM x "+fmtTr(dt,1)+"°F",cSelc);
  addRow("Tons",fmtN(q/12000,2),"Btu/h / 12,000",cSelc);
  addRow("GPM per ton",fmtN(IFTE(q>0,gV(28)*12000/q,0),2),"at this temp difference",cText);
  addRow("Range",fmt1(dt)+"°F","entering - leaving",cText);
  IF gV(32)>0 THEN addRow("Approach",fmt1(MIN(gV(29),gV(30))-gV(32))+"°F","leaving water - wet bulb",cText); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcWall()
BEGIN
  LOCAL a:=2*(gV(33)*gV(34)+gV(33)*gV(35)+gV(34)*gV(35));
  LOCAL dt:=gV(37)-gV(38);
  LOCAL q:=a/gV(36)*(gV(37)-gV(38));
  addRow("Surface",fmtTr(a,1)+" ft²","walls, ceiling and floor",cText);
  addRow("U",fmtN(1/gV(36),4),"1 / R, Btu/h ft² °F",cText);
  addRow("Temp diff.",fmt1(dt)+"°F","outside - box",cText);
  addRow("Heat gain",ithou(q)+" Btu/h","area x U x temp diff.",cSelc);
  addRow("Per day",ithou(q*24)+" Btu/24h","x 24 hours",cSelc);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcProd()
BEGIN
  LOCAL w:=gV(39);
  LOCAL ti:=gV(40);
  LOCAL tf:=gV(41);
  LOCAL fz:=gV(42);
  LOCAL p1, p2, p3, tot;
  p1:=w*gV(43)*MAX(0,ti-MAX(tf,fz));
  p2:=IFTE(ti>fz AND tf<fz,w*gV(44),0);
  p3:=w*gV(45)*MAX(0,MIN(ti,fz)-tf);
  tot:=p1+p2+p3;
  addRow("Above freezing",ithou(p1)+" Btu","lb x cp x temp drop",cText);
  addRow("Freezing",ithou(p2)+" Btu","lb x latent heat",cText);
  addRow("Below freezing",ithou(p3)+" Btu","lb x cp below x temp drop",cText);
  addRow("Total",ithou(tot)+" Btu","",cSelc);
  addRow("Per hour",ithou(tot/gV(46))+" Btu/h","over "+fmtTr(gV(46),1)+" h pull-down",cSelc);
  addRow("Per 24 h",ithou(tot*24/gV(46))+" Btu/24h","for the box total",cText);
  IF ti<tf THEN addRow("Check","warming","final is above entering",cWarn); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcBox()
BEGIN
  LOCAL sm:=gV(47)+gV(48)+gV(49)+gV(50);
  LOCAL tot:=(gV(47)+gV(48)+gV(49)+gV(50))*(1+gV(51)/100);
  addRow("Loads",ithou(sm)+" Btu/24h","walls + product + air + other",cText);
  addRow("With safety",ithou(tot)+" Btu/24h","+ "+fmtTr(gV(51),1)+"%",cText);
  addRow("Equipment",ithou(tot/gV(52))+" Btu/h","over "+fmtTr(gV(52),1)+" h run time",cSelc);
  addRow("Tons",fmtN(tot/gV(52)/12000,2),"",cSelc);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcLeak()
BEGIN
  LOCAL ty:=gV(53);
  LOCAL hfc:=gV(54)==1;
  LOCAL fc:=gV(55);
  LOCAL rt:=IFTE(gV(57)==1,gV(56)/gV(55)*365/MIN(gV(58),365)*100,gV(56)/gV(55)*100);
  LOCAL lim:=IFTE(gV(53)==2,20,IFTE(gV(53)==3,30,10));
  LOCAL ap, nt;
  IF hfc THEN
    ap:=fc>=15 AND ty<>5;
    nt:=IFTE(ty==5,"res./light comm. A/C is excluded",IFTE(fc>=15,"84.106: 15 lb or more","84.106 starts at 15 lb"));
  ELSE
    ap:=fc>=50;
    nt:=IFTE(fc>=50,"82.157: 50 lb or more","82.157 starts at 50 lb");
  END;
  addRow("Leak rate",fmtN(rt,1)+"%",IFTE(gV(57)==1,"annualizing method","rolling average"),cSelc);
  addRow("Rule",IFTE(ap,"applies","does not apply"),nt,IFTE(ap,cText,cDim));
  addRow("Limit",istr(lim)+"%",IFTE(ty==2,"commercial refrigeration",IFTE(ty==3,"industrial process","comfort cooling / other")),cText);
  IF ap THEN
    IF rt>lim THEN
      addRow("Over limit","repair","within 30 days of this addition",cBad);
      addRow("Tests","","initial in 30 days, follow-up in 10 more",cWarn);
    ELSE
      addRow("Under limit","no repair","required by the rule",cGood);
    END;
    IF hfc AND gV(56)>=1.25*fc THEN addRow("Chronic","report","125%+ of charge in a year: by Mar 1",cBad); END;
  END;
  addRow("Records","","keep 3 years",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcEvac()
BEGIN
  LOCAL k:=gV(59);
  LOCAL cl:=gEpaCls(gV(59));
  LOCAL big:=gV(60)>=200;
  LOCAL nw:=gV(61)==1;
  LOCAL nm:={"low-pressure","medium-pressure","high-pressure","very high-pressure"};
  LOCAL rf:=choiceList(7);
  LOCAL vac;
  IF gV(62)>1 THEN
    addRow("Small appl.",IFTE(nw AND gV(62)==2,"recover 90%","recover 80%"),IFTE(gV(62)==2,"compressor runs","compressor dead")+IFTE(nw,"",", pre-1993 unit"),cSelc);
    addRow("Or","4 in Hg vacuum","82.156(b)(3)",cText);
    addRow("Rule","","82.156(b): 5 lb or less, sealed",cDim);
    RETURN 1;
  END;
  addRow("Class",nm(cl),IFTE(gEpaP(k)>0,fmtTr(gEpaP(k),1)+" psia liquid at 104°F","named in 82.152"),cText);
  IF cl==1 THEN
    addRow("Evacuate to","25 mm Hg abs.","about 28.9 in Hg vacuum",cSelc);
  ELSE
    vac:=0;
    IF cl==3 AND big THEN vac:=IFTE(nw,10,4); END;
    IF cl==2 THEN vac:=IFTE(nw,IFTE(big,15,10),4); END;
    addRow("Evacuate to",istr(vac)+" in Hg vac.",rf(k)+", "+IFTE(big,"200 lb or more","under 200 lb"),cSelc);
  END;
  addRow("Recovery unit",IFTE(nw,"1993 or later","before 1993"),"Nov 15, 1993",cText);
  addRow("Not major","0 psig","repair without opening to air",cText);
  addRow("Oil change","5 psig","82.156(a)(1)(iii)",cText);
  addRow("Table","","40 CFR 82.156 Table 1",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcChg()
BEGIN
  LOCAL ad:=gV(63)-gV(64);
  LOCAL rc:=gV(66)-gV(65);
  addRow("Added",fmtN(ad,2)+" lb",fmtLbOz(ad),cSelc);
  IF gV(65)>0 OR gV(66)>0 THEN
    addRow("Recovered",fmtN(rc,2)+" lb",fmtLbOz(rc),cSelc);
    addRow("Net",fmtN(ad-rc,2)+" lb",IFTE(ad>=rc,"into the system","out of the system"),cText);
  END;
  addRow("In ounces",fmtN(ad*16,1)+" oz","added",cText);
  addRow("Record","","type, amount, appliance, date",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcInv()
BEGIN
  LOCAL lb:=gV(67)*gV(68);
  LOCAL pt:=gV(69)*(1+gV(70)/100);
  LOCAL rf:=gV(71)*gV(72);
  LOCAL sb:=gV(67)*gV(68)+gV(69)*(1+gV(70)/100)+gV(71)*gV(72)+gV(73);
  LOCAL tx:=(gV(69)*(1+gV(70)/100)+gV(71)*gV(72))*gV(74)/100;
  addRow("Labor","$"+fmtN(lb,2),fmtTr(gV(67),2)+" h x $"+fmtTr(gV(68),2),cText);
  addRow("Parts","$"+fmtN(pt,2),"cost $"+fmtN(gV(69),2)+" + "+fmtTr(gV(70),1)+"%",cText);
  addRow("Refrigerant","$"+fmtN(rf,2),fmtTr(gV(71),2)+" lb x $"+fmtTr(gV(72),2),cText);
  addRow("Trip","$"+fmtN(gV(73),2),"",cText);
  addRow("Subtotal","$"+fmtN(sb,2),"",cText);
  addRow("Tax","$"+fmtN(tx,2),fmtTr(gV(74),3)+"% on parts + refrigerant",cText);
  addRow("Total","$"+fmtN(sb+tx,2),"",cSelc);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcMark()
BEGIN
  LOCAL c:=gV(75);
  LOCAL mk:=gV(76)/100;
  LOCAL mg:=gV(77)/100;
  LOCAL pr;
  IF mk>0 THEN
    pr:=c*(1+mk);
    mg:=mk/(1+mk);
  ELSE
    pr:=c/(1-mg);
    mk:=IFTE(mg<1,mg/(1-mg),0);
  END;
  addRow("Price","$"+fmtN(pr,2),"selling price",cSelc);
  addRow("Profit","$"+fmtN(pr-c,2),"price - cost",cText);
  addRow("Markup",fmtN(100*mk,1)+"%","of cost",IFTE(gV(76)>0,cText,cSelc));
  addRow("Margin",fmtN(100*mg,1)+"%","of price",IFTE(gV(76)>0,cSelc,cText));
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcTime()
BEGIN
  LOCAL st:=gV(78)*60+gV(79);
  LOCAL en:=gV(80)*60+gV(81);
  LOCAL mn, hr, rg, ot;
  IF en<st THEN en:=en+1440; END;
  mn:=MAX(0,en-st-gV(82));
  hr:=mn/60;
  rg:=MIN(hr,MAX(0,40-gV(84)));
  ot:=hr-rg;
  addRow("Worked",istr(IP(mn/60))+" h "+istr(mn MOD 60)+" min",fmtN(hr,2)+" hours",cSelc);
  addRow("Regular",fmtN(rg,2)+" h","up to 40 h a week",cText);
  addRow("Overtime",fmtN(ot,2)+" h","over 40 h, x 1.5",IFTE(ot>0,cWarn,cText));
  addRow("Pay","$"+fmtN(rg*gV(83)+ot*gV(83)*1.5,2),"today",cSelc);
  addRow("Week",fmtN(gV(84)+hr,2)+" h","so far, with today",cText);
  RETURN 1;
END;

convFactor(k)
BEGIN
  IF k==1 THEN RETURN {2.326,1}; END;
  IF k==2 THEN RETURN {4.1868,1}; END;
  IF k==3 THEN RETURN {0.0624279606,1,0.001}; END;
  IF k==4 THEN RETURN {1,12000,3412.14163,1000}; END;
  IF k==5 THEN RETURN {1,0.145037738,14.5037738,0.491154152}; END;
  RETURN {0.00755987283,0.000125997881,1,1/3600};
END;

calcConv()
BEGIN
  LOCAL u:=convUnits(gV(85));
  LOCAL f:=convFactor(gV(85));
  LOCAL fr:=MAX(1,MIN(SIZE(convUnits(gV(85))),gV(87)));
  LOCAL bv, k;
  bv:=gV(86)*f(fr);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(u) DO
    addRow(u(k),fmtE(bv/f(k)),IFTE(k==fr,"entered",""),IFTE(k==fr,cSelc,cText));
  END;
  IF gV(85)<=2 THEN addRow("Note","","differences only: references differ",cDim); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

toolCalc(t)
BEGIN
  clearRows();
  IF t==1 THEN calcPoints(); END;
  IF t==2 THEN calcPerf(); END;
  IF t==3 THEN calcSat(); END;
  IF t==4 THEN calcSup(); END;
  IF t==5 THEN calcFlow(); END;
  IF t==6 THEN calcDisp(); END;
  IF t==7 THEN calcVe(); END;
  IF t==8 THEN calcRate(); END;
  IF t==9 THEN calcWater(); END;
  IF t==10 THEN calcWall(); END;
  IF t==11 THEN calcProd(); END;
  IF t==12 THEN calcBox(); END;
  IF t==13 THEN calcLeak(); END;
  IF t==14 THEN calcEvac(); END;
  IF t==15 THEN calcChg(); END;
  IF t==16 THEN calcInv(); END;
  IF t==17 THEN calcMark(); END;
  IF t==18 THEN calcTime(); END;
  IF t==19 THEN calcConv(); END;
END;

// ================= screens =================

drawHome()
BEGIN
  LOCAL k, x, y, c, l1, l2;
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,239,cBg);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,20,cPanel);
  TEXTOUT_P("REFCYCLE",G1,6,3,3,cText);
  rtext("cycle & service",218,6,1,cDim);
  chip("HELP",224);
  chip("EXIT",272);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO 20 DO
    x:=((k-1) MOD 4)*80;
    y:=23+IP((k-1)/4)*43;
    IF k<=gNT THEN
      c:=gTCat(k);
      l1:=gTile1(k);
      l2:=gTile2(k);
    ELSE
      c:=6;
      l1:="Learn";
      l2:="notes";
    END;
    RECT_P(G1,x+2,y,x+77,y+40,gCatC(c));
    RECT_P(G1,x+2,y,x+77,y+2,gCatL(c));
    IF l2=="" THEN
      ctext(l1,x+40,y+14,2,cWhite);
    ELSE
      ctext(l1,x+40,y+7,2,cWhite);
      ctext(l2,x+40,y+22,2,cWhite);
    END;
    IF k==gHome THEN box2(x,y-2,x+79,y+42,cSelc); END;
  END;
  BLIT_P(G0,G1);
END;

drawTool()
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  LOCAL n:=SIZE(sl);
  LOCAL k, s, x0, y, txt, big, fv;
  toolCalc(gTool);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,239,cBg);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,20,gCatC(gTCat(gTool)));
  TEXTOUT_P(gTName(gTool),G1,5,3,3,cWhite);
  chip("HELP",272);
  // input boxes, two per row
  FOR k FROM 1 TO n DO
    s:=sl(k);
    x0:=((k-1) MOD 2)*160;
    y:=24+IP((k-1)/2)*20;
    TEXTOUT_P(slotName(s),G1,x0+4,y+4,1,cDim);
    IF k==gTSel AND gEnt THEN
      RECT_P(G1,x0+74,y,x0+157,y+17,cSelc,cHit);
      txt:=entText()+"_";
    ELSE
      RECT_P(G1,x0+74,y,x0+157,y+17,IFTE(k==gTSel,cSelc,cEdge),cPanel);
      txt:=slotText(s);
    END;
    big:=DIM(txt)<=11;
    TEXTOUT_P(txt,G1,x0+78,y+IFTE(big,2,4),IFTE(big,2,1),cText);
  END;
  // results
  y:=24+IP((n+1)/2)*20+3;
  LINE_P(G1,0,y-2,319,y-2,cEdge);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gRL) DO
    IF (k MOD 2)==0 THEN RECT_P(G1,0,y,319,y+14,cRow); END;
    TEXTOUT_P(gRL(k),G1,5,y+2,1,cDim);
    // a long value and note together: the value in the small font
    fv:=2;
    IF textw(gRV(k),2)+textw(gRN(k),1)>220 THEN fv:=1; END;
    TEXTOUT_P(gRV(k),G1,90,y+IFTE(fv==2,1,2),fv,gRC(k));
    rtext(gRN(k),316,y+2,1,cDim);
    y:=y+15;
  END;
  drawMenu({"EDIT","RESET","< PREV","NEXT >","HOME"});
  BLIT_P(G0,G1);
END;

openTool(t)
BEGIN
  gTool:=t;
  gTSel:=1;
  gEnt:=0;
  gScr:=2;
END;

goHome()
BEGIN
  gHome:=gTool;
  gEnt:=0;
  gScr:=1;
END;

toolsMenu()
BEGIN
  LOCAL t:=gTool;
  IF CHOOSE(t,"Tools",gTName) THEN
    IF t>=1 THEN openTool(t); END;
  END;
  gDown:=0;
END;

// RESET: the tool's example values
resetTool()
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(sl) DO
    gV(sl(k)):=gDef(sl(k));
  END;
  gEnt:=0;
END;

// open tile k: a tool, or the Learn pages
openTile(k)
BEGIN
  gHome:=k;
  IF k>gNT THEN
    learnMenu();
  ELSE
    openTool(k);
  END;
END;

// ================= input handling =================

// returns 0 to quit
onHome(ev)
BEGIN
  LOCAL mx, my, k;
  IF TYPE(ev)==6 THEN
    IF ev(1)==0 THEN gDown:=1; END;
    IF ev(1)<>3 OR gDown==0 OR SIZE(ev)<3 THEN RETURN 1; END;
    gDown:=0;
    mx:=ev(2);
    my:=ev(3);
    IF my<21 THEN
      IF mx>=272 THEN RETURN 0; END;
      IF mx>=224 THEN showHelp(); END;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    k:=IP((my-23)/43)*4+MIN(3,IP(mx/80))+1;
    IF my>=23 AND k>=1 AND k<=20 THEN openTile(k); END;
    RETURN 1;
  END;
  IF ev==7 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome==1,20,gHome-1); END;
  IF ev==8 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome==20,1,gHome+1); END;
  IF ev==2 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome<=4,gHome+16,gHome-4); END;
  IF ev==12 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome>16,gHome-16,gHome+4); END;
  IF ev==30 THEN openTile(gHome); END;
  IF ev==3 THEN showHelp(); END;
  IF ev==13 THEN toolsMenu(); END;
  IF ev==4 THEN RETURN 0; END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

onTool(ev)
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  LOCAL n:=SIZE(sl);
  LOCAL k, mx, my, rw, idx, dg;
  IF gTSel>n THEN gTSel:=1; END;
  IF TYPE(ev)==6 THEN
    IF ev(1)==0 THEN gDown:=1; END;
    IF ev(1)<>3 OR gDown==0 OR SIZE(ev)<3 THEN RETURN 1; END;
    gDown:=0;
    mx:=ev(2);
    my:=ev(3);
    commitEnt();
    IF my>=220 THEN
      k:=IP(mx/64)+1;
      IF k==1 THEN editSlot(sl(gTSel)); END;
      IF k==2 THEN resetTool(); END;
      IF k==3 THEN openTool(IFTE(gTool==1,gNT,gTool-1)); END;
      IF k==4 THEN openTool(IFTE(gTool==gNT,1,gTool+1)); END;
      IF k==5 THEN goHome(); END;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    IF my<21 THEN
      IF mx>=272 THEN toolHelp(gTool); END;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    // tap an input box to change it
    rw:=IP((my-24)/20);
    idx:=rw*2+IP(mx/160)+1;
    IF my>=24 AND rw<IP((n+1)/2) AND idx<=n THEN
      gTSel:=idx;
      editSlot(sl(idx));
    END;
    RETURN 1;
  END;
  // digits and the decimal point type straight into a number box
  dg:=keyDigit(ev);
  IF dg>=0 THEN
    IF gSC(sl(gTSel))==0 THEN typeKey(dg); END;
    RETURN 1;
  END;
  IF gEnt THEN
    IF ev==45 OR ev==27 THEN
      gENeg:=1-gENeg;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    IF ev==19 THEN
      backKey();
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    IF ev==4 THEN
      gEnt:=0;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    // any other key keeps the typed number first
    commitEnt();
    IF ev==30 THEN RETURN 1; END;
  ELSE
    IF (ev==45 OR ev==27) AND gSC(sl(gTSel))==0 THEN
      gEnt:=1;
      gEK:={};
      gENeg:=1;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
  END;
  IF ev==7 THEN gTSel:=IFTE(gTSel==1,n,gTSel-1); END;
  IF ev==8 THEN gTSel:=IFTE(gTSel==n,1,gTSel+1); END;
  IF ev==2 THEN bumpSlot(sl(gTSel),1); END;
  IF ev==12 THEN bumpSlot(sl(gTSel),-1); END;
  IF ev==30 THEN editSlot(sl(gTSel)); END;
  IF ev==3 THEN toolHelp(gTool); END;
  IF ev==13 THEN toolsMenu(); END;
  IF ev==4 THEN goHome(); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

// ================= main =================

EXPORT REFCYCLE()
BEGIN
  LOCAL run:=1;
  LOCAL ev;
  DIMGROB_P(G1,320,240);
  DIMGROB_P(G9,320,30);
  gEnt:=0;
  WHILE run DO
    IF gScr==1 THEN drawHome(); ELSE drawTool(); END;
    ev:=WAIT(-1);   // key code, touch event list, or -1 after a 1 minute timeout
    IF gScr==1 THEN run:=onHome(ev); ELSE run:=onTool(ev); END;
  END;
END;
